items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.content:
Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

Language: Go
Stars: 56991
Forks: 4710
items.contentSnippet:
Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
Language: Go
Stars: 56991
Forks: 4710
items.creator: alibaba

summaries.zh: 阿里巴巴开源的代码审查工具，具备安全、高效等特点，已在阿里大规模实践中验证。该工具采用确定性管道与LLM Agent结合的混合架构，支持精确行级评论，内置涵盖NPE、线程安全、XSS及SQL注入等检测的多语言规则集，并兼容OpenAI与Anthropic。项目由Go语言编写，在GitHub上获星超5.2万。
summaries.en: Alibaba's open-code-review is a secure and efficient code review tool designed for large-scale operations. It utilizes a hybrid architecture that combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent to provide precise line-level feedback. The tool features a built-in multi-language ruleset to detect issues such as NPE, thread-safety risks, XSS, and SQL injection. It is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic models and is written in Go. The project has gained significant traction on GitHub, accumulating over 52,000 stars.

summaries.zh: 该项目是一个面向编程智能体的本地视频编辑工具，基于Python开发。它集成了42个FFmpeg工具，提供机器可读契约和MCP服务器，支持Claude Code、Cursor和Codex等环境。主要功能包括视频剪切、字幕添加、画面重构、响度调整及多平台导出。项目无需云端服务或API密钥，目前在GitHub上已获得超8000星标。
summaries.en: The `kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill` repository provides a local video editing toolkit specifically designed for coding agents. It features 42 FFmpeg tools equipped with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, ensuring compatibility with platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. The tool supports essential editing functions such as cutting, captioning, reframing, and loudness adjustment, along with platform exports. It operates entirely locally without requiring cloud services or API keys. Written in Python, the project has gained significant traction on GitHub, amassing over 8,100 stars and 765 forks.
